completeness: Global, complete for diameters above about 1-2 km; not a boulder or small-crater catalogue
frame: Catalogue coordinates are planetocentric, east-positive; used here as MOON_ME

source.label: Robbins (2018) Lunar Crater Database, USGS Astrogeology Science Center
source.citation: Robbins, S. J. (2018). A new global database of lunar impact craters >1-2 km: 1. Crater locations and sizes, comparisons with published databases, and global analysis. JGR Planets, 124. doi:10.1029/2018JE005592
source.instruments: LRO LROC WAC and LOLA (NASA), Kaguya Terrain Camera (JAXA)

transformation: Kept circle-fit latitude, longitude and diameter; longitude moved to -180..180; sorted by latitude; stored as float32
